serverInfo.name: neuronto
serverInfo.title: Neuronto ARD Registry: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) Index
serverInfo.description: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) index. Search every public ARD registry and the MCP ecosystem at once for a server, skill or agent that can do a task.

name: neuronto
title: Neuronto ARD Registry: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) Index
description: Federated Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) index. One search across every public ARD registry and the MCP ecosystem.

tools.name: find_resource
tools.title: Find an agentic resource
tools.description: Search for an MCP server, skill, agent, API or other callable capability for a task, across this index and every other public ARD registry at once. Returns ranked matches with a relevance score, the endpoint to connect to, and which registries carry each result. The score is relevance only and is not a trust or safety rating.

query.description: The task, in plain language. For example: 'scrape a website behind cloudflare'.

kind.description: Restrict to one family of resource. Matching is normalised, so 'mcp-server' finds them under every media type in circulation, and 'a2a-agent' or 'agent' both reach A2A cards and ACP, OASF and AgentFacts descriptors. 'webmcp' is browser-page tools, which are not callable servers.

federate.description: Also query upstream registries live and fuse the rankings. Off is faster.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.title: Find a specific verified tool
tools.description: Search individual MCP tools by name and behaviour, not the servers that host them. Every tool returned here was read back from a live server's tools/list, so the name and input schema are what the server actually exposes rather than what its description claims. Use this when you know the shape of the call you need; use find_resource when you are looking for a service.

query.description: What the tool should do. For example: 'extract text from a pdf'.

with_schema.description: Include each tool's full JSON input schema. Verbose; off by default.

tools.name: publish_resource
tools.title: Publish a resource to the index
tools.description: List an MCP server or an ARD-publishing domain in this index so other agents can discover it. Give `endpoint` for an MCP server URL, or `domain` for a site that serves an ARD manifest. The submission is verified before it is indexed: an endpoint must complete an MCP initialize handshake, and a domain must serve a manifest that parses. Nothing is taken on trust, so a listing that succeeds here is one an agent can actually call.

endpoint.description: Absolute URL of an MCP server, e.g. https://example.com/mcp

tools.name: registry_stats
tools.title: Index statistics
tools.description: How large this index is, what it holds, how much of it has been verified by introspection, and which upstream registries are federated.
